title: introduce-unified-stream-throttle-and-retry-profiles-add-fluent-streaming-builder-and-sdk-bumps
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Users across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs reported inconsistent streaming backpressure hints and divergent retry semantics that cause duplicate partial responses and suboptimal batching. This PR converges three concerns: 1) a unified, explicit backpressure/throttle hint model; 2) a small family of retry profiles with consistent semantics across SDKs; 3) an ergonomic fluent builder API for streaming options to make common patterns simple and reduce misuse. Scope: changes touch the three SDK packages, a small protocol header for optional hints, updated docs and end-to-end tests. Backwards compatibility: new headers and structured options are optional. When callers use the old ad-hoc flags the SDK translates them to the new model so there are no breaking runtime changes for existing customers. Design summary: - Introduce StreamingThrottleHint (Soft|Hard|Adaptive + numeric target tokens_per_sec) to express consumer preferences. - Introduce RetryProfile (fast-retry, conservative-windowed, idempotent-only) with well-defined backoff and idempotency rules. - Add FluentStreamingOptions builder in each SDK to compose throttle + retry + diagnostics (e.g., progress callbacks, chunk policy). - SDKs annotate outgoing requests with X-Stream-Hint and X-Stream-Retry-Profile when available (opaque, opt-in). Implementation notes: - Python: new streaming.builder.StreamingOptions class with chainable methods and a from_legacy_flags adapter. - TypeScript: StreamingOptionsBuilder exported from client/streaming and used by examples and docs. - Go: StreamingOptions struct + option funcs to follow idiomatic functional options pattern. - Small runtime change: server accepts the new optional headers; when present runtime will attempt to honor Soft hints and prefer batching heuristics for Adaptive. Migration notes: - Existing apps keep working. - Recommended migration: replace ad-hoc kwargs with StreamingOptions builder to get predictable batching and retries. - Release notes include code snippets showing before/after for each language. Tests: unit + integration harness added to verify: 1) throttle hint propagates through gateway and affects batching decisions in the perf canary; 2) retry profile semantics maintain idempotency during streaming aborts; 3) cross-language parity tests that exercise identical behavior across py/ts/go. Checklist: - [x] Spec and design doc linked in Linear ENG-1987 - [x] Implementations in py/ts/go - [x] Unit tests + integration tests - [x] Docs + snippets updated - [x] Version bumps for SDK releases - [x] CI green (flaky linter fix for TS was addressed) Migration snippet (Python) BEFORE: client.stream(prompt, max_tokens=256, retry=True, backoff=0.5) AFTER: opts = StreamingOptions().with_throttle_soft(tokens_per_sec=120).with_retry_profile('conservative-windowed') client.stream(prompt, max_tokens=256, options=opts)

review_comments:
Rohit Desai (reviewer): Can we avoid adding a new runtime header unless it's strictly necessary? It increases attack surface and complexity.
Ava Martinez (author): The headers are opt-in and are not required for compatibility. They simplify debugging and make it explicit when an SDK is requesting batching behavior. We can gate header emission behind a feature flag for early rollouts.
Linda Chen (reviewer): TS lint failed on first run, please run prettier/tsc. Also please add a small example showing error handling with the builder.
Ava Martinez (author): Fixed lint issues, added example for error handling and a test for malformed builder input.
Marco Alvarez (reviewer): Go idiomatic comment: prefer functional options pattern as implemented, but rename WithThrottle to ThrottleSoft/ThrottleAdaptive for clarity.
Ava Martinez (author): Renamed functions and updated docs.
Rohit Desai (reviewer): unit tests look good; integration flaky in CI due to timing. Please add increased timeouts and a retry on the parity job.
Ava Martinez (author): Added retry to the GH action matrix and increased timeouts.
Linda Chen (reviewer): Approve after CI green and one minor doc nit (fixed).
release_notes:
- Add unified StreamingOptions builder across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs (non-breaking).
- Introduce optional X-Stream-Hint and X-Stream-Retry-Profile request headers for opt-in server behavior.
- Add new retry profiles (fast-retry, conservative-windowed, idempotent-only).
- Bump SDK versions: python 1.17.0, typescript 2.9.0, go 0.14.3.
- Update streaming docs with migration examples.
